temporal.rationale: Chronological transfer to future dates; respects annual seasonal window; no tuning on test
temporal.requires: At least one reviewed scene before and after 2021/2022 split per site

leave_one_glacier_out.rationale: Spatial transfer across Himalayan sites; each glacier held-out once
leave_one_glacier_out.requires: At least 2 independent reviewed scenes per site covering 2016-2025

strategy.unit: Entire acquisition per site+date is assigned to one fold; no pixel-level split. All patches from same scene stay together.
strategy.forbidden: Any source scene, tile, or composite sharing acquisition date appearing in both train and test; pixel-level random split

current_snapshot.note: Only 5 single-date 2025 stacks exist (4 candidate, 1 rejected tsho-rolpa). No approved_reviewed labels yet, so no concrete train/test assignment. Strategy above is frozen; concrete records will populate once Phase 3 labels are approved.

validation: Automated leakage check: assert no scene_id or observation_date appears in both folds; fail if violated. Implemented in train_segmentation.py:load_records() via (site_id, observation_date) key.
